entities.title: Only the everyday shapes have a type
entities.summary: Typed values exist for Gregorian dates, year-months, times and date-times (unzoned, fixed-offset or IANA-zoned), POSIX instants, calendar periods, POSIX and SI second counts, and start-end intervals of dates or instants.
entities.impact: Any other valid UTV value (recurrences, other calendars, a zoned date, a floating date-time with a resolutionPolicy, extra properties) gives unsupported (unsupported-operand) from FromJson and Parse.
entities.workaround: Use the JSON layer, which holds any UTV value as a JsonElement.

entities.title: Period components are 64-bit
entities.summary: Period holds each component as a long, unlike years, which are BigInteger.
entities.impact: A calendar amount whose component does not fit in a long gives unsupported (implementation-limit) from Period.FromJson and Period.Parse. Period.Negate throws OverflowException for long.MinValue.
entities.workaround: The JSON layer's Calendar.Add reads components as BigInteger.

entities.title: The typed policies name only what is implemented
entities.summary: Gap has Reject, PreserveUnresolved and ShiftForward; Overlap has Reject, All, Earliest and Latest.
entities.impact: The schema's other policies (shift-backward-by-gap, next-valid-boundary, previous-valid-boundary, offset-match, occurrence-index) have no typed name. Built through the JSON-layer GapPolicy and OverlapPolicy enums, they give unsupported (unsupported-policy).
entities.workaround: An offsetAssertion on the value picks one side of an overlap, as offset-match would.
